modern: In conversation you must pay attention to what is said, and in every movement you must observe what is being done. And in the one you should see immediately what end it refers to, but in the other watch carefully what the thing signified is.
original: In discourse thou must attend to what is said, and in every movement thou must observe what is doing. And in the one thou shouldst see immediately to what end it refers, but in the other watch carefully what is the thing signified.
notification: In conversation you must pay attention to what is said, and in every movement you must observe what is being done.
notification_original: In discourse thou must attend to what is said, and in every movement thou must observe what is doing.

explained.summary: Pay real attention. When someone speaks, notice what they’re actually driving at; when something is done, look at what it really amounts to. Marcus is training himself not to take words and actions at face value but to see their purpose and meaning.
explained.today: In a meeting, it’s worth asking what a colleague’s suggestion is really for rather than reacting to how it was phrased. With a friend’s offhand remark, listening for what they mean usually gets you further than answering the literal words.
